IF at 'W_Shortened completion ' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Call after offers'
IF at 'W_Handle leads' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Complete application'
IF at 'A_Submitted' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Handle leads'
IF at 'A_Create Application' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'A_Submitted'
